name: Mini Pupper 2
def: Small open source quadruped kit built around a Raspberry Pi and ROS 2, aimed at students learning navigation and mapping.
body: Mini Pupper 2 descends from the Stanford Pupper design and ships as a kit with twelve servo driven joints, a Raspberry Pi compute module, a small display face and an optional lidar. Its software runs ROS 2 with simultaneous localisation and mapping and navigation examples, plus interfaces for vision and voice, so it can carry a full robotics course on cheap hardware. MangDang funded it on Kickstarter in late 2022 and sells both assembled and self build versions.
facts: Crowdfunded in late 2022 and supplied as an open source ROS 2 teaching kit
Derived from the openly published Stanford Pupper design
specs: Camera, optional two dimensional lidar, inertial measurement unit
ROS 2 stack with mapping and navigation on a Raspberry Pi
